headline: Activist unveils AI-generated 3D-printed gun called the WASP
summary: Gun-rights activist Cody Wilson unveiled what he calls the first AI-made firearm, a 3D-printed .22 caliber handgun called the WASP, designed using an AI tool he calls GatGPT.

claims.statement: Gun-rights activist Cody Wilson unveiled what he calls the first AI-made firearm, called the WASP.

sources.quote: Now he's claiming another first: "the first AI-made gun." It's called the WASP.
A gun rights activist has unveiled the world's first AI-made 3D printed firearm.

claims.statement: The AI tool used to generate the gun's design is called GatGPT.

sources.quote: created by an 'AI that can generate guns' called GatGPT

claims.statement: The gun is a 3D-printed .22 caliber handgun.

sources.quote: .22 caliber handgun created by an 'AI that can generate guns'
